Requirements & technical notes (shorthand):
- Network: require AWS PrivateLink (interface endpoints) into customer VPC for control plane + data plane; Transit Gateway allowed if PrivateLink insufficient. No public internet egress from Redwood nodes — egress must route through customer-managed NAT or egress proxy.
- IP allowlists: customer will provide strict CIDR blocks; Redwood endpoint must support static IP ranges or fixed endpoint IPs for firewall whitelisting.
- Firewall rules: deny-all-by-default; allow only ports 443 outbound to Redwood PrivateLink endpoints; restrict management interfaces to SRE bastion subnets. Support for internal security groups and explicit SG rules required.
- Egress controls: need to enforce egress through their HTTP proxy for DLP/logging. Redwood must support TLS inspection bypass via mTLS to customer proxy or peered NAT.
- Peering/Transit: customer prefers PrivateLink; fallback to VPC peering + route table updates if PrivateLink can't meet throughput. Must document route propagation and VPC CNI interactions.
- KMS: BYOK required. Integration with customer KMS (AWS KMS + CloudHSM) for model artifacts and cache encryption. Key rotation policy: 90 days acceptable; need key-rotation playbook. Key usage audit logs must be forwarded to customer SIEM.
- Audit logging: full request logs, token-usage metadata, model version tags; retention 7 years for audit team. Logs must integrate with Splunk/Datadog via secure forwarder.
- Data residency: strict US-only region (us-east-1 primary, us-west-2 failover). No replication outside approved regions.
- Performance targets: chat p95 <100ms for short-turn latency, embeddings throughput target 200-300 qps for batch jobs. POC will validate p95 and cold-start behavior.
POC plan (agreed):
- 2-week POC in customer VPC using Redwood Private endpoints. Scope: chat + embeddings, KMS BYOK, audit forwarding to Splunk.
- Day 0: exchange network diagrams, create PrivateLink endpoint, provide test certs.
- Day 3-5: smoke tests (connectivity, handshake, logs).
- Week 2: performance run + security review.
